subject: Numbers Huddle: end-of-week commit sprint & fast triage
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Numbers Huddle: end-of-week commit sprint & fast triage

Team —

Quick note ahead of today’s 11:00 huddle. Finance wants a tight commit set by EOD Friday; I want us to enter final-stage moves and any rollback risks into the tracker by 5pm PDT so we can finalize the submission. Key asks: 

- Update stage to Commit (or Stalled/No Go) in HubSpot for any deals you want counted. Add a one-line reason in the "Close Plan" field if moving to Commit.
- Paste the HubSpot deal link and the expected close date to the commit_tracker.csv (attached).
- If there are open procurement/legal asks blocking a commit, drop a short note in this thread and tag Marissa.

Attachments: forecast_template.xlsx (template), commit_tracker.csv (please update rows for your reps).

Agenda for 11:00 huddle (20m):
1) Rapid roll call — which deals hitting Commit this week (1 min/deal)
2) Top 3 at-risk deals and mitigation owner
3) Quick checklist: PO/Legal, Docusign ready, enablement/training plan
4) Final submission owner & time (I will upload to Finance)

If you cannot join the 11:00, post your updates into the tracker before 10:30 so I can represent your book.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

--
Attachment stubs: forecast_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), commit_tracker.csv (text/csv)
